Title: Elite & Ultimate Variants
Description:
Elite & Ultimate Variants - Add challenging enhanced creature variants to Caves of Qud!

  ⚠️ NEW IN v1.1.0 - MAJOR BALANCE UPDATE:
  • Drastically reduced Tier 8 loot: Elite 1%, Ultimate 5% (was 10%/30%)
  • All presets compensated with more spawns and higher Tier 7 rates
  • High-tier loot is now truly rare and valuable
  • Lower spawn rates: Elite 20%→10%, Ultimate upgrade 30%→15%
  • Later progression: Elites level 10→15, Ultimates level 20→25

  FEATURES:
  • Elite Variants - Silver-glowing enhanced creatures (2.0x-3.0x stat multipliers)
  • Ultimate Variants - Gold-glowing boss enemies (3.5x-6.0x stat multipliers)
  • Elite Armies - Coordinated groups with leader-goon dynamics
  • 5 Difficulty Presets - Easy (25%) to Nightmare (100%) with smart scaling
  • 40+ Wish Commands - Full customization and testing capabilities

  MOST IMPORTANT COMMANDS:
  • elitepreset - Instantly apply difficulty preset via selection menu
  • eliteautopreset - Enable automatic preset changes from options menu

  QUICK START:
  1. Enable the mod
  2. Press ` (backtick), type: eliteautopreset
  3. Options → Mods: Elite Variants → Select preset (Normal recommended)
  4. Play! Elites spawn at level 15+ in tier 5+ zones

  DIFFICULTY PRESETS:
  Easy (25%) - Relaxed | Normal (50%) - Balanced | Hard (75%) - Challenging
  Brutal (87.5%) - Very Hard | Nightmare (100%) - Maximum Challenge

  All settings customizable via Options menu: power/HP/enhancement multipliers, spawn rates, mutation caps, equipment tiers,
   and more.

  COMPATIBILITY:
  ✓ Works with vanilla and modded creatures/tiles
  ✓ Mid-save safe - add/remove anytime
  Note: Preview shows custom tiles from other mods

  Full documentation: github.com/SattaRIP/elite-ultimate-variants
